United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative:
This workplan has been developed solely for the overhead costs associated with the GPE project budget.
Despite Viet Nam’s rapid socio-economic growth and progress in achieving universal access to basic education, persistent inequalities remain. To address key bottlenecks for education system transformation, UNESCO and UNICEF will serve as co-grant agents for the GPE System Capacity Grant (2026–2028), supporting the Ministry of Education and Training. The project focuses on three high-impact areas: 1) inclusive early childhood education, 2) disability-inclusive education, and 3) data strengthening with digital transformation, to drive equity, inclusion, and quality for all learners. UNESCO will lead Component 3 and co-lead Component 2 with UNICEF.
